title: Tanker GKG share z>1 -> short JETS 3d
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] GDELT tanker GKG share 20d z-score > 1 signals jet-fuel cost shock that hits airlines harder than parcel freight (-); trade short JETS 3d at 3d lag [gdelt.gkg.tanker_share -> finance.JETS.log_return] (parent: R2-0066)

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.tanker_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short JETS next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 3 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Tanker GKG share 20d z-score > 1 predicts airlines underperform the market (JETS/SPY ratio falls) over 5d at 1d lag, isolating the relative fuel-cost effect from broad risk-off (-) [gdelt.gkg.tanker_share -> finance.ratio.jets_spy] (parent: R2-0169)
